title: China Sourcing Agent for Overseas Buyers
description: China sourcing agent in Zhuhai helping overseas buyers find suppliers, normalize RFQs, coordinate samples, control quality, consolidate goods and prepare export delivery.
h1: A China sourcing agent built for buyers who need control, not another supplier list.
intro: Pomerol International acts as a China-side sourcing and execution layer for overseas buyers. We turn product requirements into a structured sourcing brief, compare suppliers on the same commercial and technical basis, coordinate samples and revisions, define quality checkpoints, and keep the path to shipment visible.

Search by manufacturing process and technical fit

title: China Quality Inspection & Pre-Shipment QC
description: China quality inspection support covering sample baselines, incoming controls, dimensional checks, packaging verification and pre-shipment inspection coordination.
h1: Quality inspection starts before the inspector arrives.
intro: A pre-shipment inspection is only useful when the acceptance criteria are defined in advance. We help buyers convert drawings, approved samples, functional requirements and packaging standards into practical inspection checkpoints.
problem: Generic 'check quality' instructions create subjective inspections. The more technical the product, the more important it is to define critical dimensions, material evidence, electrical configuration, visual zones, test method and allowable deviation before production.
scope: Approved sample and golden sample control
workflow: Align factory and buyer on the baseline
Inspect at the right production stage
Close corrective actions before shipment release
buyers: Useful for custom parts, electrical products, OEM goods, packaging, furniture, hospitality supplies and multi-factory consolidation programs.
keywords: china quality inspection, pre shipment inspection china, qc inspection china, china product inspection

title: China Factory Audit & Supplier Verification
description: China factory audit and supplier verification support for overseas buyers evaluating manufacturing capability, documentation, process controls and commercial risk.
h1: Verify the factory behind the quotation before the risk moves into production.
intro: Supplier verification should answer a practical question: can this organization reliably make the specified product at the required volume and control level? We separate legal identity, manufacturing capability, evidence, process controls and commercial claims.
problem: Trading companies, subcontracted processes, borrowed certificates and unclear production ownership can all create hidden risk. A good verification process makes those relationships visible before the buyer commits tooling or production money.
scope: Business identity and factory relationship review
workflow: Use findings in the sourcing decision
buyers: Best for first orders, custom tooling, long-term supply programs, safety-relevant products and projects where supplier continuity matters.
